description: MainFragment class for an Android app, managing UI interactions for notes, including navigation, file attachments, photo capture, and menu actions.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing main notes UI, including navigation, file attachment, photo capture, and menu actions.

methods.name: actionToEditor
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the editor, with optional note ID, attachments, and list flag.

methods.name: actionToSearch
methods.description: Creates navigation directions to the search screen with optional query.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles note click event, navigating to editor.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click on note, showing menu.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on selection state.

methods.name: onLayoutModeChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when layout mode changes.

methods.name: onSortMethodChanged
methods.description: Updates UI when sort method changes.

methods.name: goToEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the note editor, optionally with note ID, attachments, and shared element.

methods.name: setupFab
methods.description: Initializes Floating Action Button for creating new notes.

methods.name: setLayoutChangeActionIcon
methods.description: Sets icon for layout mode toggle in menu.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Highlights current sort method in menu.

methods.name: setupBottomAppBar
methods.description: Configures bottom app bar menu actions for creating list, recording audio, attaching files, and taking photos.
